result.title: ReAccess: Look Once, Stay Focused with Efficient Test Time Memory
result.summary: Despite recent advances, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with fine-grained visual understanding, often failing to effectively utilize critical evidence already encoded in their visual representations. Existing approaches address this limitation through repeated visual processing or explicit reasoning, introducing substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we propose ReAccess, a lightweight framework that preserves and reuses question-relevant visual evidence through compact associative memory. Constructed during a single visual prefill, the memory supports progressive evidence retrieval that steers both attention queries and hidden representations, enabling effective visual grounding without repeated image encoding or explicit reasoning traces. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both general visual understanding and fine-grained perception, while achieving substantially faster inference than existing reasoning-intensive approaches, demonstrating a promising path to efficient multimodal reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReAccess，在一次视觉 prefill 中构建紧凑关联记忆来保存并复用与问题相关的视觉证据，并通过渐进式证据检索调控注意力查询与隐状态，从而避免重复图像编码与显式推理轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「视觉证据能否留在内部状态并被答案真正使用」这一问题，其单次编码加记忆复用可作为降低 LOOK 成本、缓解视觉信息坍缩的可核查替代路径；记忆里究竟存了什么、以及答案是否因果依赖它，仍需读原文确认。
